title: ShotLedger sessions export
description: The file produced by Settings → Export Sessions. `format` is always "shotledger.sessions". An importer must refuse a higher `formatVersion` rather than dropping fields it does not understand. This URL always describes the CURRENT format version, today 1; pin https://jimisola.github.io/shotledger/reference/v1/sessions-export.schema.json instead if you need it to stay put.

formatVersion.description: Bumped only for a breaking change. An importer must refuse a higher version rather than dropping fields it does not understand.

generatedAt.description: When the file was written, ISO 8601.

name.description: The application that wrote the file.

app.description: What wrote the file — for support, never for import decisions.

id.description: Stable id of the session. An import matches on this to update rather than duplicate.

type.description: Whether the session was training or a competition.

disciplineId.description: Discipline id, e.g. `spsf-precision`. Free text: an import may name one this build does not define.

programId.description: Shot-program id within the discipline, or null for no fixed format.

competitionLevel.description: Competition level (forening, krets, landsdel, national, riks), or null for training.

isChampionship.description: Whether the competition was a mästerskap — KM, DM, SM. A flag on the level, not a level of its own.

competitionName.description: The event's own name, if it had one.

weaponGroup.description: Federation-scoped vapengrupp id, e.g. `spsf:C`. A training session takes this from its firearm rather than being asked; null when it could not be determined.

shooterClass.description: Klass the shooter entered under, e.g. `2` or `VetY`. Null on a training session — klass is a competition entry attribute.

eventId.description: ISSF event id, `<disciplineId>:<gender>:<age>`. Null for a discipline whose category rides on the klass instead, and for training sessions.

firearm.description: `"{make} {model}"`, or null if the session has no firearm.

ammoLot.description: The ammunition lot's label, or null.

location.description: Where it was shot, as free text.

decimalScoring.description: Whether scores are decimal. Affects how `valueTenths` reads, never what it stores.

extraRounds.description: Rounds fired but never scored — the whole shot count of a rounds-only session.

position.description: 1-based position of the series within its session.

isSighter.description: A sighter (provserie) is shot but not counted towards the session total.

isFinal.description: Whether the series belongs to a championship final.

position.description: 1-based position of the shot within its series.

valueTenths.description: Score in tenths of a point, so a decimal 10.9 is 109 and a whole 9 is 90. A miss is 0.

isInnerTen.description: Whether the shot counts as an inner ten (X), used for tie-breaks.

shots.description: The shots of this series, in the order they were entered.

series.description: The series of this session, in order.

sessions.description: The exported sessions. Typed loosely by the parser on purpose, so one bad session is rejected on its own rather than failing the whole file; the real shape is documented here.
